## Checklist

- [ ] The full test suite passes (`.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest discover -s tests`)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under **Unreleased**
- [ ] The README is updated if commands, settings or anything users see changed
- [ ] It works on a phone as well as a computer (for page changes)
- [ ] Nothing new goes online without the user asking, and no personal data leaves the PC
- [ ] No passwords, keys, personal chats or files from `data\`, `models\` or `files\` are included
